mapper.select: select w.withdraw_id, w.member_id, m.phone, m.real_name, w.currency, w.wallet_type_code, t.type_name as wallet_type_name, w.amount, w.fee_amount, w.arrival_amount, w.account_info, w.pay_method, w.status, w.audit_by, w.audit_time, w.audit_remark, w.pay_proof_url, w.create_time, w.remark from biz_withdraw w left join biz_member m on m.member_id = w.member_id left join biz_wallet_type t on t.type_code = w.wallet_type_code where w.withdraw_id = #{withdrawId}
mapper.insert: insert into biz_withdraw (member_id, currency, wallet_type_code, amount, fee_amount, arrival_amount, account_info, pay_method, status, create_time, remark) values (#{memberId}, #{currency}, #{walletTypeCode}, #{amount}, #{feeAmount}, #{arrivalAmount}, #{accountInfo}, #{payMethod}, #{status}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update biz_withdraw set status = #{status}, audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, pay_proof_url = #{payProofUrl} where withdraw_id = #{withdrawId} and status = '0'
